Root index status field is set to COMPLETE
.meta.json is updated to reflect COMPLETE status
A project comment is appended summarising the action

summary: Added MarkProjectCompleteResult interface and markProjectComplete() async function to src/utils/project-reset.ts. The function wraps all writes in withLock(), iterates non-CANCELLED WP summaries, writes each WP detail file with status=COMPLETE, updates the root index (status=COMPLETE, pending_work_packages=0), appends an admin_action project comment, and calls store.writeRootIndex() (which auto-syncs .meta.json).

Added handleMarkProjectComplete() to gui/api.ts with assertSafeSlug, NOT_FOUND guard, ARCHIVED FORBIDDEN guard, and delegation to markProjectComplete(). Imported both the function and the MarkProjectCompleteResult type.
Registered POST /api/projects/:slug/complete route in gui/server.ts matchRoute() following the same pattern as /archive and /unarchive. Imported handleMarkProjectComplete from api.ts.
Added markProjectComplete method to api-client.js following the same pattern as archiveProject/unarchiveProject.
TypeScript builds cleanly. All 1209 tests pass.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent with existing patterns. writeRootIndex() auto-syncs .meta.json, so no separate writeProjectMeta() call needed.

summary: All 11 acceptance criteria verified. markProjectComplete() and MarkProjectCompleteResult both exported correctly. Non-CANCELLED WPs iterated and set to COMPLETE in both detail files and root index summaries. Root index status=COMPLETE, pending_work_packages=0, project comment appended. handleMarkProjectComplete guards correctly: 404 for missing project, 403 for ARCHIVED. Route registered in server.ts. TypeScript build clean. No process.stdout writes. 1209/1209 tests pass.

comments.note: The note string is constructed twice — once inside the withLock() callback and once outside for the return value. A minor DRY opportunity; the outer note could reuse a captured variable or be derived from completedIds.

No test verifies the GUI route POST /api/projects/:slug/complete end-to-end. The unit tests in tests/gui/api.test.ts should be extended to cover: (a) happy path on a project with mixed WP statuses, (b) 404 for non-existent slug, (c) 403 for ARCHIVED project, (d) CANCELLED WPs are excluded from the completed set.

summary: Code review of mcp-server/src/utils/project-reset.ts, mcp-server/gui/api.ts, mcp-server/gui/server.ts, and mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js for the markProjectComplete backend feature.

markProjectComplete() correctly wraps all WP and root-index writes inside a single withLock() scope. CANCELLED WPs are skipped, pending_work_packages is zeroed, last_updated is refreshed, and a project comment with type='admin_action' and agent='GUI' is appended before the single writeRootIndex() call (which auto-syncs .meta.json).

handleMarkProjectComplete() in api.ts applies assertSafeSlug, ledgerDirExists NOT_FOUND guard, readRootIndex NOT_FOUND guard, and ARCHIVED FORBIDDEN guard in the expected order before delegating to the utility. Route registration in server.ts and api-client.js entry follow the existing /archive and /unarchive patterns exactly.
Three low-priority observations logged (duplicate note string, rootIndex! non-null assertion, void slug pattern). None block PASS.

comments.note: mcp-server/src/utils/project-reset.ts markProjectComplete() — The note string is constructed identically in two places: once inside withLock() to populate rootIndex.project_comments[].note, and once outside to populate the return value's project_comment_added field. If the construction logic ever changes, both sites must be updated in sync. Fix: capture a variable before returning (e.g., let noteText: string; inside the lock, assign noteText = ..., then use it in both the push and the return).

mcp-server/gui/api.ts handleMarkProjectComplete() — rootIndex! non-null assertion on line ~693 is used because TypeScript cannot prove the catch branch throws (notFound() throws an HttpError but is not typed as 'never'). This is acceptable but could be eliminated by typing notFound() as returning 'never', which also benefits the other handlers that use the same pattern.

mcp-server/src/utils/project-reset.ts markProjectComplete() — The unused void slug; pattern is honest documentation that the parameter exists for call-site clarity but the slug is already bound on the store. Consider promoting the slug to a store-level getter if multiple utility functions end up in the same situation, to make the intent explicit in the type signature.
